author: Vilius Vo

title: SCAM
body:
I canceled my subscription and still got charged FOUR TIMES within minutes. This is not a “forgot to cancel” issue — this is unauthorized, duplicate billing.

I accepted the first charge when I missed the trial deadline, but charging me €40 in multiple transactions after cancellation is completely unacceptable. After this happened, I checked reviews and realized this is a recurring pattern with this app.

Cancellation is misleading, billing is aggressive, and customer trust is clearly not a priority. I’ve disputed the charges with my bank and blocked this merchant.

Avoid this app unless you want to risk surprise charges and hours dealing with refunds.

title: Charges after cancellation
body:
This is a scam. I paid a small fee for a trial version and then read the reviews online - everyone was saying the app continues charging full fee (~30$) even if you cancel the plan. I did cancel within the first hour, did that on their website as it was advised by other users, and yet they also charged me. Avoid this app at all costs.
